## [1.2.0](https://github.com/V4inwald/wispr-flow-patches/compare/v1.1.0...v1.2.0) (2026-11-15)

### ✨ New Features

* move to the 2.x patch generation and sign every release ([a512c7c](https://github.com/V4inwald/wispr-flow-patches/commit/a512c7c3e8868b1f5a758e24c208ebfab2c54be4))

patches.name: Play Store install source
patches.description: Reports the app as installed from the Play Store, so the bundled Play licensing check accepts a re-signed build.

patches.name: Unlimited words
patches.description: Removes the free-plan weekly word limit, so dictation keeps working past the quota.
